description: Atlyn Markdown Viewer renders rich Markdown directly inside Power BI reports so authors can add executive summaries, methodology notes, report guides, release notes, data definitions, formatted tables, lists, links, and syntax-highlighted code. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown patterns, sanitized rendering, Power BI formatting controls, keyboard access, report themes, high contrast, safe host-mediated links, rendering events, and both empty-space and rendered-content context menus. Common uses include narrative reporting, documentation, KPI commentary, and styled analytical annotations. The visual is free for personal and commercial use under the MIT License; no purchase, subscription, account, or license key is required.
